title: Study Workflow System (StudyLoop)
summary: Local-first desktop application built with Go, Wails, Vue 3, SQLite, and FSRS focused on guided learning workflows, spaced repetition, and offline RAG.
highlights: Driven by a persistent SQLite study queue enforcing deterministic priority ordering and crash-resilient session recovery.
Integrates FSRS (Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler) algorithm for optimal flashcard retention and review session management.
Uses ONNX Runtime local inference and sqlite-vec (vec0) for offline vector embeddings and topic-scoped RAG retrieval.
Built with Go backend desktop shell using Wails v2 and Vue 3 frontend with hash-based routing.
Implements a 2-strike Socratic rescue pipeline to remediate repeated quiz failures before unblocking progression.

title: Voice Agent Platform
summary: Modular voice agent system built with Python, FastAPI, PydanticAI, PostgreSQL, pgvector, and WebSockets for real-time speech pipelines and RAG workflows.
highlights: Architected a full-duplex WebSocket audio pipeline minimizing Time-To-First-Audio (TTFA) through sentence-boundary clause chunking.
Implemented real-time Voice Activity Detection (VAD) using Int16 PCM energy RMS sliding-window thresholding and silence windowing.
Spearheaded modular provider adapters for STT (Groq Whisper), LLM (Groq Llama 3.3 70B), TTS (Cartesia Sonic), and Embeddings (Jina AI).
Integrated vector similarity search using Jina AI text embeddings and pgvector for domain-specific RAG retrieval.

title: WalletOS
summary: API-first wallet management platform for wallet operations, transaction history, tenant-based auth, and audit logging built in an Nx monorepo.
highlights: Engineered pessimistic locking (SELECT FOR UPDATE) with lexicographic lock ordering to prevent double-spending and deadlocks under concurrent writes.
Architected a three-app Nx monorepo (Express API, Next.js user UI, Next.js admin dashboard) with isolated auth boundaries.
Enforced 30-day write idempotency, request fingerprinting, and database-level write/update revocation on immutable audit logs.
Built an asynchronous webhook delivery subsystem featuring HMAC-SHA256 signing, DNS-based SSRF protection, and circuit breakers.

title: Forge CLI
summary: Windows CLI written in Go that automates project initialization from reusable templates by orchestrating Git, Python, uv, and npm.
highlights: Architected a zero-dependency Go binary executing ecosystem binaries directly via native process calls to eliminate shell injection risks.
Designed an isolated dry-run workspace testing framework (forge test) enabling validation of template workflows in temporary workspaces.
Built atomic remote template distribution pipelines (forge pull) with ZIP stream inspection and volume-aware cross-drive fallback mechanisms.
Implemented non-blocking background binary self-deletion and PowerShell-based PATH environment updates on Windows.

title: Mind Palace Study Tool
summary: AI-assisted study application utilizing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and local vector databases with Python, Streamlit, and MongoDB.
highlights: Implemented an on-device RAG engine using INT8-quantized ONNX models (nomic-embed-text-v1.5) and ONNX Runtime CPU inference for zero-cost search.
Architected a single-document NoSQL schema in MongoDB aggregating PDF text, sentence vector caches, flashcards, and gamified progress tracking.
Built topic-aware context window slicing to dynamically pass top-k semantically relevant sentence chunks into Groq LLM prompts.
Developed a Socratic AI Tutor & Quiz Generator with regex-assisted JSON parsing and adaptive study schedule generators.

title: FocusPlay
summary: Desktop Pomodoro productivity application with glassmorphic UI, custom audio playback, session persistence, and profile management built using Go and Wails.
highlights: Architected a desktop application using Go (Wails v2) and Vanilla JS/CSS for a glassmorphic UI with a lightweight 6MB binary footprint.
Built a concurrent audio engine in Go using gopxl/beep featuring thread-safe volume gain control, gapless looping, and directory shuffling.
Engineered crash-resilient session persistence with atomic file writes and 24-hour expiration checkpoints for session recovery.
Implemented an event-driven IPC system using Go goroutines and Wails event emitters for 60 FPS timer rendering.
